summary.text: Paul Rumbaugh, a Nebraska Working People Party candidate and former Republican with a background in business management, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of Nebraska to Scott Petersen.
His campaign site is titled "Protecting Nebraska votes and voices," and he said he ran on transparency and accountability in the office.

paragraphs.text: Rumbaugh graduated from Omaha Central High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Bellevue University, and his career experience includes work in business management.
In his candidate survey he says he was a registered Republican until 2009, when he left the party and became nonpartisan.
Rumbaugh said he was running with the Nebraska Working People Party to protect Nebraska from being ruled by party officials and unelected officials outside the state.

He said the Secretary of State's office needed to display transparency, accountability and confidence in and for the state's citizens, and he objected to sharing voters' personal information with party insiders in Washington, D.C.
He received 3.1% of the vote to Scott Petersen's 53.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
